TPL.thesis_one_line: Owner of Permian land and royalties that gets paid as others drill and use water, but the share price already assumes a decade of fast growth.
kill_criteria: Move to INCLUDE-SMALL only if the price falls to 30x TTM EPS or below (about $235).
Exit/REJECT if quarterly total royalty volumes fall below 3.0 MMBoe (Q2'26: 3.615 MMBoe) for two consecutive quarters.
Exit if produced-water royalty volumes fall below 4,000 MBbl/d for two quarters (Q2'26: 4,872).
Exit if capex plus land purchases exceed 50% of FCF for four quarters without a disclosed return.
Exit if the credit facility is drawn above $250M.
key_adverse_facts: 43x trailing EPS, TTM FCF yield 2.3% (FCF $533.7M vs market cap about $23.5B)
Q2'26 oil realised $97.55/bbl vs $70.57 in Q1; natural gas realised $0.40/Mcf
Capex and land purchases rising ($110.2M land acquisitions H1'26); revenue includes seller-financed Chevron land sale
data_conflicts: Triage said near-zero/negative FCF yield; filings give 2.3% (b1 2.5%)
TPL.confidence_in_thesis: med: business quality verified in 10-Q; valuation call depends on oil price and water growth assumptions; date is an estimate

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 14.5% 10-year FCF CAGR vs 9% base.

TPL.scenario_basis: TTM EPS $7.85 (FCF/share about $7.74); bear EPS flat at 22x, base EPS +10%/yr at 30x, bull +18%/yr at 40x; dividend $2.40/yr growing; exit in 3 years.

TRMB.thesis_one_line: Software and positioning tools for construction and fieldwork with growing subscription revenue, priced at about 16 times adjusted earnings after a one-off write-down.
kill_criteria: Organic ARR growth below 8% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26: 12%).
Any further goodwill impairment above $250M, or the 10-K for FY2026 again reporting a material weakness (remediation not concluded).
Net debt/TTM Adjusted EBITDA above 2.5x (now 1.1x) on a consolidated basis.
Full-year non-GAAP EPS guidance cut below $3.47 (the Q1'26 low end).
key_adverse_facts: $562.0M goodwill impairment of the T&L unit in Q2'26; TTM GAAP net loss $(104.7)M; $1,621.3M T&L goodwill remains
Material weaknesses in internal control not yet remediated (10-Q Item 4: disclosure controls not effective)
SBC about $170M/yr excluded from non-GAAP EPS
H1 operating cash flow flattered by $250.4M receivable collection; Q3 guided revenue flat sequentially
data_conflicts: Triage attributed the negative ROE to a JV deconsolidation artefact; the 10-Q shows a $562.0M T&L goodwill impairment
GAAP FY26 EPS guidance flipped from +$2.05-2.21 to a loss of $0.07-0.12
TRMB.confidence_in_thesis: med: guidance beats and FCF verified; internal-control weakness and software de-rating risk keep it half weight; date is an estimate

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 3.2% (6.2% after SBC) 10-year FCF CAGR vs 9% base.

TRMB.scenario_basis: FY26 non-GAAP EPS guidance midpoint $3.65 (FCF/share about $3.32); bear EPS +4%/yr at 12x, base +12%/yr at 16x, bull +16%/yr at 19x; no dividend; buybacks implicit in EPS growth.

HLT.thesis_one_line: Fee collector on hotels owned by others, adding about 6% more rooms a year, but the stock already prices it for strong growth.
kill_criteria: Move to INCLUDE-SMALL only at 28x FY26 adjusted EPS or below (about $250), or if FY27 consensus adjusted EPS rises above $10.50.
Exit/avoid if net unit growth falls below 4.5% for two consecutive quarters (Q2'26: 6.1%).
Exit if system-wide comparable RevPAR is negative for two consecutive quarters.
Exit if net debt/TTM Adjusted EBITDA exceeds 3.8x (now 3.2x, consolidated).
Exit if FY adjusted EBITDA guidance is cut below $4,040M.
key_adverse_facts: 35.1x FY26 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint; FCF yield 2.9%
Capital return $2.03B YTD through July vs H1 FCF $1.07B; debt up $1.0B in six months to $13.4B principal
Consolidated stockholders' deficit $(6,303)M; net debt/TTM Adj EBITDA about 3.2x
GAAP net income guidance cut at Q1 and Q2 while Adj EBITDA guidance rose; Q4'25 special items not traced
data_conflicts: Triage cited 31.1x NTM P/E and 4.2x leverage; filings give 35.1x on FY26 adjusted EPS midpoint and about 3.2x net debt/EBITDA (different bases and dates)
HLT.confidence_in_thesis: med: operating results and guidance verified; the valuation call is sensitive to discount rate; date is an estimate

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF implies 10.4% 10-year FCF CAGR vs 8% base.

HLT.scenario_basis: FY26 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint $8.95; bear EPS +6%/yr at 24x, base +13%/yr at 30x, bull +16%/yr at 35x; dividend $0.60/yr; exit in 3 years.
